d:
Although the Men’s 50m Breaststroke World Record has stood for nine years, it was under constant threat at Kazan 2015 and Budapest 2017.
First, Cameron van der Burgh lowered it. Then came Adam Peaty, who broke the record three times in a row: becoming the first swimmer to go under 26 seconds in the event.
Let’s relive these incredible swims from two of the greatest breaststrokers of all time.
